rejected_rule.statement: The owner of an undivided share of land may sue a trespasser to have his title to the undivided share declared and for ejectment from the whole land.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Moreover, prima facie evidence of title is all that is required in such an action. The owner of an undivided share of land might sue a trespasser to have his title to the undivided share declared, and for ejectment of the trespasser from the whole land.

meta.parties: Hevawitarane Et Al. v. Dangan Rubber Co.,Ltd
